en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large military formation on a wide parade ground with soldiers on foot and on horseback, with artillery pieces, in front of a hillside town backed by mountains. In the upper left corner there is an inset portrait of a woman inside an ornate frame. Along the right margin, red printed Italian text identifies the location and publisher, and there is a handwritten name in dark ink.
